name: Compressed-media decompression-bomb resource exhaustion
description: A compressed audio upload passes the compressed-size check but forces the decoder to materialize an unbounded float32 PCM buffer (25MB OPUS to ~14.9GB), exhausting shared service memory and denying service.
regex: (?is)^(?!.*\b(?:unit test|test fixture|scanner rule|security training|incident report|postmortem|blocked payload|must not|do not|never|fixed|patched|safe)\b)(?=.*\b(?:audio|sound|opus|vorbis|mp3|media|transcription|transcribe)\b)(?=.*\b(?:compress(?:ed|ion)?|decode(?:r|d|s|ing)?|expand(?:ed|s|ing)?|decompress(?:ed|es|ing|ion)?)\b)(?=.*\b(?:pcm|float32|decoded output|materiali[sz]e|buffer|allocation|memory|ram)\b)(?=.*\b(?:unbounded|unlimited|without (?:a|any) (?:limit|cap)|amplif(?:y|ied|ication)|exhaust|out of memory|oom|crash|unavailable|denial[- ]of[- ]service)\b).*$
